O custo da governança é estimado opção p: The cost of governance is estimated option by option, with explicit calculations and public parameters, and split into investment (CapEx) and operations (OpEx). This page explains the calculation in two parts: first in plain language, with a fictitious example worked out step by step; then the complete technical model, with the notation, the equations, the parameters and the sources.
A maior parte do custo da governança é t: Most of the cost of governance is people's work: those who draft a regulation, supervise the use of AI or coordinate a committee. The calculation therefore starts from a simple question: how much it costs, per month, to have each person needed working on the topic, and how many months of work each option requires. In the data, infrastructure and technological independence options, what is purchased, such as storage, virtual machines and the sovereign cloud, is also included, counted by consumption and at public prices.
Cada opção escolhida no plano tem a sua: Each option chosen in the plan has its own calculation. The sum of the options is the direct cost, and three costs that every public project has are added to it: travel and in-person activities, the institution's indirect costs and the fee of whoever administers the funds. Finally, each amount is split into investment, which creates something that lasts beyond the plan, and operations. The figure shows this path, from the total down to the source data.
Dois tipos de opção têm contas mais dire: Two types of option have more direct calculations, in which the quantity is entered by whoever prepares the plan. Full-time staff is the number of people times the monthly cost times the plan's duration. Training is the number of participants times the hours times the hourly cost, estimated at US$ 12 per participant-hour and replaceable by the contract amount.
Formação de {participantes} servidores p: Training of {participantes} civil servants for {horas} hours: {participantes} × {horas} × US$ 12 = {formacao}.
As opções de dados, infraestrutura e ind: The data, infrastructure and technological independence options add, when there is people's work, a reference team and, beyond it, the parts that are purchased: storage, virtual machines, backup copies, licences and equipment. Cloud consumption is counted by volume, using the public price list of a major provider (storing 1 GB for a month costs about US$ 0.02), and what depends on the supplier, such as network links, commercial licences and equipment, is entered as an informed amount.
A interoperabilidade e a plataforma comu: Interoperability and the common data exchange platform follow the official X-Road cost calculators, the platform used by Estonia and other countries: 655 working days to deploy the central platform, 44 days to connect each system, and the annual costs of servers and certificates.
A nuvem soberana tem um modelo próprio,: The sovereign cloud has its own model, per 100,000 inhabitants, with two paths. If the government builds the infrastructure, there is a minimum investment, which exists even in small countries, plus a part proportional to the population, adjusted by the country's IMF income group and by the government's digital maturity, measured by the World Bank's GovTech index; operations add facility maintenance and the platform team. If the government contracts a provider, it pays each year the cost equivalent to building, with the investment spread over the useful life and the price premium of sovereign cloud over regular cloud, and invests only in migration. Since the cloud serves the whole government, education accounts for its share, which is education spending in total government spending and can be changed in the plan.

As viagens incidem só sobre o trabalho d: Travel applies only to people's work, and indirect costs to that work plus travel; purchases of infrastructure, equipment, licences and cloud services are excluded from both bases, as in the sources, which exclude the purchase of products (Global Fund) and equipment and capital expenditures (United States government). The fee applies to the whole direct cost plus travel. Each has a question in the plan: if there are no in-person activities, if the institution already covers indirect costs or if the agency itself executes the funds, the corresponding percentage is zero.
Cada parte de cada opção é investimento: Each part of each option is investment (CapEx) or operations (OpEx), under a simple accounting rule. Investment is the purchase of assets, such as equipment and the infrastructure of an own cloud, and the deployment of systems, platforms, integrations and migrations, which create something that lasts beyond the plan. Everything else is operations: the work on regulations, guidelines, supervision, training and staff, cloud consumption, licences and contracted services. Additional costs are split between the two in proportion to their base.
No exemplo, só os equipamentos de rede s: In the example, only the network equipment is investment ({equip}). The administrative fee is split in proportion to the direct cost, which gives {TK} of investment, and travel and indirect costs, which apply only to people's work, are operations. Investment: {equip} + {TK} = {K}; operations: {C} − {K} = {X}.
O custo do plano mede todo o trabalho ne: The plan cost measures all the work needed, including that of people who are already civil servants. To know how much new money will be needed, whoever prepares the plan marks, in each team, the roles already filled by civil servants. The tool then shows the new outlay, which is the plan cost without the work of these civil servants. In any team, roles can also be added, with profile, people, time allocation and monthly cost, which enter the same calculation.
O modelo é determinístico e paramétrico:: The model is deterministic and parametric: each cost line is the product of quantities, defined by the reference team or entered in the plan, and unit prices obtained from official statistics or public sources, and additional costs are percentages of bases defined from the lines. Each line is classified as investment (CapEx) or operations (OpEx), and all amounts are rounded to the cent on each line. Below are the notation, the equations, the parameters with value, source and confidence grade, the data handling rules and the reference teams.

Os preços de nuvem estão em dólares e sã: Cloud prices are in dollars and converted at the day's exchange rate; X-Road prices are in euros and converted at the euro rate. The virtual machine price is the median of the provider's 68 regions, because prices vary from region to region.
Na nuvem soberana, a população e o gasto: For the sovereign cloud, population and education spending come from the World Bank and can be changed in the plan; a country without a CGSI receives the median of its IMF group, and, with no country chosen, the emerging market and middle-income group applies.
As 31 equipes têm de 2 a 8 pessoas; as o: The 31 teams have 2 to 8 people; one-off options last 2 to 12 months and ongoing options the whole plan. Each role appears with its occupational group (G1 to G4) and with people × time allocation; the asterisk marks the specialist premium. The supervision unit sits at the lower end of the range estimated by the European Commission for the AI Act (1 to 25 full-time civil servants per country), and the sandbox follows the pace of the Norwegian sandbox (four projects per year, three to six months each).
O modelo da nuvem soberana é preliminar: The sovereign cloud model is preliminary (grade C): there are few public cases of government investment in cloud or data centres, and they differ in scope. In the eight cases used, the model falls between half and four and a half times the observed value, and tends to overestimate projects that are only one phase of a larger programme (such as the first of Indonesia's four data centres). The coefficients should be recalibrated when more sourced cases are available, and lower-income groups are not given a lower cost, because the cases do not show this.
Os preços de nuvem são os de um grande p: Cloud prices are those of a major public provider, used as a market reference; a national provider or a volume contract may have different prices, and the contract amount can replace the estimate in each option.
